neighbours.label: The verb 'play' (play/plays/played) and the article or 'no' right after it when a third-person subject plays a part, in English: 'Parents play a…', 'Luck plays no…', 'Seals play an…', the frame that leads to 'a ___ role/part'. Quiet for the noun 'play' (a play, the best play), weak after 'we'/'you' and in other languages, and quiet for other verbs in the same frame (serve a, hold an).
neighbours.notes: Cold step-in from bonsai1/L26/N4803- (reader, drop 0.17). Labelled from own tops and probes only. The pole is mixed: the 'play a/an/no' frame is its clearest testable family; other tops (' Pro' in Pro Bowl/PROPIOS, ' been' in 'has been very positive', first pieces of names) are separate small families not covered. Test sentences written blind by a label-only author.
